column1: Everyone would agree that Quantum Fluff is a pretty specific keyword to search for,
and selecting all the reviews that contain it is relatively simple in a digital environ-
ment. But that’s not all there is to keyword search. In data analytics, keywords are used
to distinguish between positive and negative feedback. You can identify positive
reviews by searching for messages that include keywords often linked with positive
opinions and vice versa. While a star-based score can give you an idea about the overall
product performance, keywords can tell you how happy (or unhappy) your clients are
with specific aspects of your offering. Performing this task at regular intervals can, for
